project.name: Fowlis Easter
project.boundarySource: Verified named-place position with a conservative strict editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Completed as an individual, strict-boundary audit on 2026-09-02. Nearby attractions and facilities are excluded unless they lie inside the defined visitor study area.

touristAppeal.label: Notable Stop
touristAppeal.summary: Fowlis Easter earns a modest map place for its exceptional medieval church, compact historic core, Den walk and verified public parking. Limited church access and the absence of a qualifying café or public toilet cap the score.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access is useful with responsible close control; indoor policies must be checked separately.

visitorHighlights.name: Fowlis Easter Parish Church
visitorHighlights.reason: The medieval church is the village’s defining visitor asset, with access limitations stated clearly.
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: First Sunday of each month at 11:00 for public worship; other access by advertised event or arrangement.
